newsitem.title: ITALY: Small bomb explodes at U.S army base in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Small bomb explodes at U.S army base in Italy.

text.p: A small pipe bomb exploded in the mail room of the U.S. Army's Camp Darby in Italy on Sunday night, causing minor damage and no injuries, U.S. military officials said on Monday.
A statement from the Southern European Task Force (SETAF) said damage from the bomb was minimal and no group had claimed responsibility.
A spokesman said the explosive damaged a table and a bulletin board in the mail room of the camp, near the city of Pisa.
The statement said the bomb exploded during the annual summer carnival festivities at the camp, which is a logistics depot.
SETAF, which is based in Vicenza, said that for security reasons the carnival was closed. The explosion was being investigated by Italian and U.S. military authorities.
